answer: Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. By the ember of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on independent re-execution of receipts before any claim. Each submission hangs on the vertex of a task receipt, and the grove is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short.
